notes.title: Streamer's Journey Released Today!
notes.content:
[h3]This is our first hentai novel and we are incredibly happy that it is finally available to everyone! And completely [b]FREE[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45373175/b91a71de7448ea225edbd6d1ee5182605ceb6782.png[/img]

Please enjoy the game!

If you like it, consider support us and buy dlc with additional art

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539190/Streamers_Journey__Supporter_Pack_Artbook/

and add our next game in the series to your wishlist, where you have to become a streamer manager yourself.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301610/Streamer_Manager_Simulator/

join our discord to stay updated💖
